title: After a slow connection, 'Try again' on a member import can drop those members' plans and payments
what: When a batch of new members is sent but the answer never comes back, the import marks those rows as not saved and offers Try again. If the save had in fact landed, Try again now finds them already in the gym and calls them 'Already a member.' Their plans and payments from the old software are then not sent at all, and the row is no longer marked as waiting, so nothing tells the owner the money history is missing.
expected: Members that a late save brought in are counted as added, and their plans and payments are still imported (or clearly left waiting).
how_often: only when an import save times out but lands
fix_line: On Try again, treat a member the earlier save already brought in as added and still send their plan and payment

title: MettleUp cannot see how member imports go
what: The member import is the first big step for a new gym, but nothing records how many imports start, finish, stop half-way, or whether the AI column matching was used or fell back. Problems are only written to the owner's own browser. Whether the import and its AI matching help gyms get started is decided blind.
expected: Each import sends a small count-only summary (rows added, waiting, skipped, AI used or not) that HQ can see.
fix_line: Send a count-only import summary to HQ
